package.name: coco_nav_diag
package.description: C2-NAV.36 diagnostic instrumentation only. Contains a version-matched, default-disabled fork of nav2_amcl 1.3.11's AmclNode (renamed to coco_nav_diag::AmclNode, built as a separate `amcl_diag` executable so it never collides with the installed nav2_amcl package or executable) that records the exact scan-stamped odom TF lookup and motion-model delta it consumes, when explicitly enabled via the diag_enabled parameter. Answers "what odometric motion did AMCL actually consume", which nothing else in this repository records. Not wired into any existing launch file; it is opt-in, swapped in for a dedicated diagnostic run. See docs/agents/HANDOFF.md.
